correctness.rationale: Exact derivation and automorphism matrices follow from generator relations; direct conjugation yields a, hb-at/h, h²c+a(t/h)²-2au/h. For a=0, delta=c/b² when b≠0 and square classes when b=0 classify all residual cases. Counts sum to q³, all characteristics incl 2,3. The actual standalone verifier exhaustively checks algebra identities, matrix action and orbits for q=2,3,4,5,7,8,9. No use of finite tests as infinite proof.
